sections.description: AstroStar is a responsive and multipurpose WordPress astrology theme. The theme is a great solution for astrology, horoscopes, zodiac signs, and other astrology related websites or blogs. It is fully integrated with the WooCommerce plugin, so you can easily add payment and store options to your site. Our WordPress astrology theme is one of the best themes available for WordPress. It comes with a lot of great features and takes care of your website's page speed, SEO, and other important things. AstroStar comes with a powerful and beautifully designed homepage with many sections such as a banner section with different templates, WooCommerce sections, advantages and services sections, etc. All these sections are fully customizable so you can change the default content and design. Additionally, there is a drop-down option and you can easily change the order of these sections (this option is only included in the premium version of the theme). Our WordPress astrology theme has many benefits, so we will mention some of them. First, you can change the theme fonts, there are 10 popular fonts available in the free version (plus 40 fonts in the premium version). Secondly, different layouts are available for the blog page, search page, single pages, single posts, shop page, and product pages. There are 3 layouts available for each type of these pages. Additionally, the top bar has 3 available layouts, the header has 2 available layouts, and the footer has 6 available layouts. Another benefit of AstroStar is its full integration with WooCommerce. This means you have control over the design and layout of your store and product pages. You can change the style of almost every element. Moreover, the theme improves the functionality of WooCommerce and adds some great features like products search bar, sales section, etc. The WordPress astrology theme has many advantages and we are sure that the best way to check all the advantages is to install and test the theme yourself. By the way, you can check out the theme's demo page and see it in action.
